data.name: Giriraj
data.gender_notes: Giriraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Giriraj means the one who rules over the mountains. It is derived from two Sanskrit words 'Giri' which means mountain and 'Raja' which means king. The name is often given to a boy who is believed to have the strength and power of a mountain king. The name Giriraj carries the meaning “Mountain King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Giriraj usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Giriraj is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the name invokes the blessings of Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as the lord of the mountains. The name is also associated with the concept of 'Tapas', which means spiritual discipline and penance. It is believed that a child named Giriraj will grow up to be a strong and disciplined individual, with a deep connection to the spiritual world.
data.etymology: Giriraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Giriraj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The name evokes a sense of strength, stability, and awe, reminiscent of the grandeur and majesty of mountain ranges found in India and other parts of the world.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Giriraj is a name of Lord Vishnu, meaning 'mountain king'. The name Giriraj carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
